meta.sweeps: pool: multi-parcel legs at their own price (one seller repeating one price at >= 1.5x floor = a bundle order, never)
meta.excluded: override specials (Godmode/Plague/seeds/Lith0), Plague chroma, bundles, wash, self-trades
meta.mode: at the sale: Terrain until the parcel's first Daydreaming/Terraformed event (parcel_dreams, build_dream_history.js)
meta.alpha_selection: single fit, side as a feature

ask_premium.note: ask = bid x this. One fit, is-ask indicator; guarantees ask >= bid for every parcel.

floor_calibration.note: Solved against settled sales, not against the index/live-floor ratio — that ratio measures the lag between a trailing index and a point sample, and swings hardest exactly when the floor moves. Re-measured every 24h by ops/daily-refit.sh, after the fit it corrects.
